Knights of Braveland is available now!

Heroes Guild awaits you. Only you can defeat all the infamous villains threatening the kingdom.

Knights of Braveland is a cooperative beat'em up action game with a generated story. Join the Heroes Guild and travel the path from a rookie to the hero of the kingdom. notes.title: Monsters of uncharted planet
notes.content:
Hi, spacelanders! Another communication window is open so it is time to update you on the enemies, our heroes will meet in their adventure.
 
Roaches

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/5706dd96d83fefda5fbc52b7d3fc447cf165f16c.gif

First on the list - strong bugs  with "explosive" temper. They are covered with a durable chitinous shell and posess an unstoppable desire to knock down anyone spotted using a signature push. These “friendly” creatures are aboriginals of the cold planet and they will not tolerate neither neighbors nor guests in their own home.

Creeper

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/24e111295c84b13746d7ae4d8ee6766c9540eaf6.gif

Next in line are creepers — a family of dexterous and tough animals. Their origin is completely unknown. It is they who became the main threat to the space base.


 Small creeper is a nimble animal with blades on the upper limbs. Why does he need them in the wild - one can only guess, but they perfectly pierce human armor. Shooting at medium and long ranges is recommended.
 Medium creeper is a heat-loving creature that can dig long holes. Playing catch is not a good idea. With a powerful jump, creature can overcome several meters and become a real threat.
 Red creeper is the most mysterious species. Why does he have crystals in his skin and how did they get there - no one knows. Some suggest that it is the human influence, others argue that it has always been like that. The increased toughness of this beast is unlikely to please fans of killing enemies with a single shot.


Redback Shooter

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/83cc1b6147b0154265bd396ba6612fe7ca3e9677.gif

An intelligent monster of mysterious origin. Handles weapons as an experienced military, aggressive pretty much always. But who he is and what is his purpose - these secrets have yet to be figured out.

Bronton

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/3897e043e7194aa8ea8d90cb8573364fac3f360d.gif

And our last exhibit is armored like a real tank - a kind of creature brought to the frozen planet by humans. They say, once it resembled a tortoise and was of a very modest size. However, after some time this creature turned into a strong, albeit slow beast. And now it is a real threat to humans. The only way to fight it is to shoot it in the back – the least protected part of it’s body.

notes.title: Battle missions
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/a7d856cdd0ad346454a23fc9d239df9fabe2a609.png

Hi, Spacelanders. We mentioned that we are making fast-paced XCOM, but not without tactical diversity. When creating game mechanics, we focus on such old school games as Incubation, Laser Squad, Fallout and others. And this means that various objectives, intricate levels and enemies that can surprise you are waiting for you. We will try to illustrate this with examples of some missions from our tactical strategy.

Mission: Dangerous Bridges
In this mission, a very unusual level is waiting for the player. Its landscape consists of seething X-matter, vaguely reminiscent of lava. A few meters above it a few flimsy bridges are stretched over, which you can move across. But they are so unstable that they support the weight of only one creature, otherwise they collapse directly into the boiling liquid. The sophisticated maneuvers are complicated by mutants, slowly but surely gripping your squad in a vice. You have to constantly decide when to give battle to the enemies and when it is better to retreat.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/92bc1dcede2130fa30a0919ae5c7c37ce59f1d17.gif

Mission: Deadly Chase
Monsters are following the trail of your squad, and soon there will be an endless stream of then from the open elevator shafts. If you do not block the entrances in time, they will quickly surround you and simply outnumber you. You are short on people and ammo, time is running out, you need to act exceptionally coordinated and fast. The enemy can’t be allowed to lure your squad into a lengthy battle or it will be the last one and acting separately may be unnecessarily dangerous. Ingenious tactical planning is extremely required.

Mission: Divide and Conquer
During this not simple task you will have to act in two independent groups. The squad must pass through two long adjacent corridors, which are divided into several closed sections. Each separating door requires access to a terminal located in the other corridor. Thus, the life of one group always depends on the right actions of the other. In addition, coordination within each pair of fighters is important. It is necessary to save ammunition and choose who get the next supply, as well as to make decisions about when to use the abilities of the heroes.

Feedback
Feel free to write in comments what kind of other missions you want to see in Spaceland.

notes.title: Meet the hero: Barret
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/9585b8d28b62d62f591c440bfb1ae1e3001ea380.gif

Hi, Spacelanders! We continue to talk about the key characters of Spaceland. This time it is Barrett's turn. Teammate of Jim, whom we talked about last time.

Barret
Barrett has seen a lot in his lifetime, and knows perfectly what the ranger life tastes like. To save lives, he has to act quickly, regardless of the rules. Because of this, a brave sergeant often gets into unpleasant situations and has many problems with his superiors. He spits on the bureaucratic instructions that make up the staff rats in his offices.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/8fb02ffa80807722cf5694551099ad819c1ee7a0.gif

Shotgun: deadly at short range, but almost useless at long distances.

However, those who were able to earn the respect or even the sympathy of Barrett know him as a cheerful and loyal comrade who will never abandon his friends. He grew up on a farm and he is used to difficulties. That makes him not only a hot-tempered and wayward ranger, but also a fierce fighter. The brave sergeant is not afraid to meet the enemy face to face, because this is the perfect chance for him to feed his foes with bullets.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/3e21481fc7f385b0bc7f87f307da83ffbd814a41.gif

Pistol: secondary weapon with unlimited ammo.

Witty and bully, Barret behaves appropriately, rushing to the barricades headlong. With the help of his faithful shotgun, the sergeant mercilessly gets rid of the enemy at close range. It is also hard to overestimate his ability to throw frag grenades. A successful throw of such a baby can destroy a whole group of enemies. "We act first, then we think about the outcome!" - this is the motto of this fearless ranger.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/f604b689b2188db682dbac20cfbcd771ac499221.gif

Special abilities
What other special abilities would suit Barrett best? Feel free to offer your ideas.

notes.title: Meet the hero: Jim
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/1af78b97d62a9cb0f6f4c7fb1e1a69ded12c07e6.png

It's time to talk about the key characters of our story. And today we will tell you about one of the two star pilots who caught the distress signal from an unknown planet. Meet space ranger Jim.

Jim
Jim recently joined the rangers, and he has yet to earn the respect of his associates. He grew up in an educated and wealthy family, so even after joining the services he did not lose his good manners. Jim believes in justice and trustworthiness of the command, and will  follow any orders ... If they do not contradict his high ideals.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/9dad676245a56707005e05c55fdf67a8a09aa71e.gif

Assault rifle. Еffective at medium distances, large ammunition. Burst: dense rifle fire, causing increased damage, but spending more ammo.

Since the boy’s youth passed in comfort, surrounded by his father's books, the constitution of the young soldier leaves much to be desired. Jim is thin and does not possess outstanding physical data, but he compensates this with agility and quick reflexes. To the surprise of his colleagues, he is a good shot and has a not bad handle on cold arms, especially one-handed swords. Perhaps, due to the plasma sword fighting lessons, which are mandatory for all the students of private schools.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/09dc15683b63328d1816e26ff096dcf820d4e04a.gif

One-handed sword. Used in melee, causes great damage from behind.

Jim is the perfect scout, relying on his speed in combat. A large reserve of action points allows him to actively maneuver and even engage in the melee with the enemy. He is also able to make medium distance dashes, so, for example, he can strike an enemy from the back and cause additional damage. In ranged combat Jim relies on an assault rifle, which has a large ammunition and the ability to fire bursts.

Ability. Dash
The ability to quickly get close to the enemy or avoid encirclement.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/47e06dc19554cab854e4e52b6f3a876f0c87557f.gif

Ability. Mine 
A small anti-personnel surprise, invisible to the enemy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/357efd93ed73d891fd37b18331143dcebc14ca07.gif

Don't forget to add Spaceland to your wishlist. ;)

notes.title: Fast-paced XCOM
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829109/1f46d2b470b0344b82f311f8945a8943b68dd167.gif

In April we’ve made the official announcement of our turn-based strategy called Spaceland, the actions of which take place in a futuristic entourage. How much does it differ from our previous creation - the Braveland fantasy trilogy – and what should you expect from our new creation? We will try to answer these questions.

Fast-paced XCOM
While creating the game, we focused on such mastodons like XCOM and Fire Emblem, but at the same time paid attention to modern state of gaming. Nowadays, not everyone wants to get stuck on a difficult mission for an hour or two, that’s why we made our plays last from 5 to 15 minutes. So you’ll get a dynamic tactical gameplay with short but exciting levels, flashy FX and capacious characters speeches. Such fast pace and overall liveliness of the gameplay does not let you get bored, continually supporting your interest.

Braveland storyline development
Tortuga Team followers call our new game “Braveland in space,” but everything is much more interesting! Braveland's original trilogy was a tribute to HOMM series and other hexagonal strategies. Spaceland relies on games such as the classic XCOM, Incubation and Laser Squad. The plot is inspired by the books of the “golden age” of science fiction and futuristic games of the past. Therefore, compared with the fantasy trilogy, our space strategy is significantly deeper. Spaceland diligently develops the plot and interaction between the characters, moving to a new level of narration. Heroes are more complex, with their own sympathies, conflicts and other delights of a close team.

Spaceland gets harder
But it’s not just the setting that distinguishes the lands of the brave adventurers from the space rangers. It is important to understand that Spaceland draws inspiration from the squad turn-based strategies of the past, and therefore has a fair amount of difficulty geting close to the midcore genre, and some missions may even feel hardcore. You may remember Incubation – a wonderful game, were levels sometimes resembled multimove combination of puzzles. Tortuga Team is not going to crush the player with impossible tasks, but tactical skills and inquisitiveness of the mind definitely will not be out of place.

We will continue to share with you details about our new game Spaceland. You could share your opinion with us. Should Spaceland be more hardcore or rather midcore like Braveland?

Hi, Spacelanders!

Tortuga Team are glad to announce our new tactical scifi adventure. The game inspired by XCOM and legendary sci-fi novels. Lead team of space rangers, outsmart alien monsters and discover secrets of uncharted planet.

Some interesting facts:

 Spaceland is PAID game. No microtransactions
 Spaceland is more like xcom-blitz. One battle is about 10-15 minutes
 Someone called our game Braveland in space. Maybe... But we call it XCOM meets Fire Emblem
 Spaceland is more hardcore than Braveland series
